art_instructions: Draw a friendly interaction between Panda and Dinosaur in a cozy woodland setting. Panda should be positioned on the left side of the frame, standing upright with a gentle, welcoming expression. Her large black ear tufts and eye patches should be clearly visible, with bright, curious eyes and a small button nose. Dinosaur should be on the right side, slightly smaller in scale to emphasize Panda's presence, with his round snout, big expressive eyes, and short tail clearly shown. His pea-green scales and pale mint belly should be visible, and he should be smiling wide as he eagerly responds to Panda's invitation. Both characters should be drawn in chibi style (2-3 heads tall) with rounded silhouettes and minimal detail. Use smooth monoline strokes with dark brown/charcoal lines. The background should be simple with soft gradients and gentle patterns to highlight the characters. Position the camera at eye level to maintain the child's perspective.
